page.layout: One page of running text. Running head at top centre. Side note in the left margin beside the first lines. Headings and short statements centred in the text block. Catchword at lower right. Show-through from the facing page is ignored.

main_text.p: 4. Re-gnum ÆgyptiKairovvanæ occupavit. Cujus successores Ægypto expugnatâ condide-runt urbem Alcahiram, quæ inposterum sedes Imperii & Chalifatus fuit.
main_text.head: Periodus III.
Canon.
Chalifatus Ægypti pervenit ad Sultanos.
Explicatio 1.
main_text.p: Extinctâ Fatimidarum familiâ in Ægypto, loco Chalifarum, Sultani sive Imperatores regnarunt: primò quidem Mahmudus, cognomento Nu-radin; ei successit Sahladinus, conditor familiæ Ajobidarum i. e. ex posteritate Jobi. Nam Sahladinus originem suam referebat ad Jobum illum patientem,
main_text.head: Explicatio 2.
main_text.p: Extinctâ Ajobitarum familiâ successerunt Turcomanni A. C 1250[?] longâ serie.

page.notes: Show-through from the facing page (faint words such as "Canon", "Chalifatus", "Ka..." and the "E 4" signature at the foot) is not transcribed. The "Kairovvanæ" spelling and "1250" (raised 0) are read from the scan and may be doubtful. The catchword "Ex" has a mark after it that is uncertain. The left side note is read as printed, hyphenated across three lines.
